verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is a dependency-free C/C++ inference engine that runs models locally on CPU (AVX/NEON), Apple Metal, and CUDA/HIP GPUs, including CPU+GPU hybrid, via a local CLI and a local server with a built-in web UI. Many community users report running models on their own Macs and desktops, and one calls it 'very nice for something self-hosted.' Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that prompts and data never leave the device (no telemetry), and documentation of fully offline operation (the shown -hf flow fetches models from Hugging Face).
